name: quizbuks-storefront
description: QuizBuks for Shopify: the storefront's quiz block, a plain Web Component built into the Theme App Extension's quiz.js (docs/quizbuks/shopify/S2b-ui.md section 2). No React, no @jabiz/ui: it runs inside a merchant's theme within a size budget.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --mode player && node scripts/size.mjs && node scripts/extension.mjs
